name: Yamanoue no Okura
bio: Yamanoue no Okura (山上憶良, c. 660 – c. 733) was a Nara-period court official and poet. He travelled to Tang China in 702 as a member of the Japanese embassy, later served as governor of Chikuzen in Kyushu, and is remembered as the Man'yōshū's poet of poverty, old age, sickness and love for his children.
The originals of the poems chosen by Saitō Mokichi in his 万葉秀歌 (1938) are given here from the 1891 Kogi reading text of the Man'yōshū (鹿持雅澄訓訂) on Wikisource, each titled by its Kokka taikan number.

poems.title: MYS 63: いざ子ども早日本辺に (Iza kodomo haya Yamatobe ni)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 1. 題詞: 山上臣憶良が、大唐に在りし時、本郷憶ひてよめる歌
poems.text: いざ子ども早日本辺に大伴の御津の浜松待ち恋ひぬらむ

poems.title: MYS 337: 憶良らは今は罷らむ (Okurara wa ima wa makaramu)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 3. 題詞: 山上臣憶良が宴より罷るときの歌一首
poems.text: 憶良らは今は罷らむ子泣くらむ其も彼の母も吾を待つらむそ

poems.title: MYS 797: 悔しかもかく知らませば (Kuyashi kamo kaku shiramaseba)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 5. 題詞: 日本挽歌一首、また短歌
poems.text: 悔しかもかく知らませば青丹よし国内ことごと見せましものを

poems.title: MYS 798: 妹が見し楝の花は (Imo ga mishi ōchi no hana wa)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 5. 題詞: 日本挽歌一首、また短歌
poems.text: 妹が見し楝の花は散りぬべし我が泣く涙いまだ干なくに

poems.title: MYS 799: 大野山霧立ち渡る (Ōnoyama kiri tachiwataru)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 5. 題詞: 日本挽歌一首、また短歌
poems.text: 大野山霧立ち渡る我が嘆く息嘯の風に霧立ち渡る

poems.title: MYS 801: 久かたの天道は遠し (Hisakata no amaji wa tōshi)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 5. 題詞: 惑へる情を反さしむる歌一首、また序 (反し歌). The headnote does not itself name Okura; the ascription follows the surrounding 山上憶良 headnotes and 左注
poems.text: 久かたの天道は遠し黙々に家に帰りて業を為まさに

poems.title: MYS 803: 銀も金も玉も (Shirokane mo kugane mo tama mo)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 5. 題詞: 子等を思ふ歌一首、また序 (反し歌). The headnote does not itself name Okura; the ascription follows the surrounding 山上憶良 headnotes and 左注
poems.text: 銀も金も玉も何せむにまされる宝子にしかめやも

poems.title: MYS 888: 常知らぬ道の長手を (Tsune shiranu michi no nagate o)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 5. 題詞: 筑前の国司守山上憶良が、熊凝に為りて其の志を述ぶる歌に敬みて和ふるうた六首、また序
poems.text: 常知らぬ道の長手を暗々といかにか行かむ糧は無しに

poems.title: MYS 893: 世間を憂しと恥しと (Yo no naka o ushi to yasashi to)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 5. 題詞: 貧窮問答の歌一首、また短歌 (反し歌). The headnote does not itself name Okura; the ascription follows the surrounding 山上憶良 headnotes and 左注
poems.text: 世間を憂しと恥しと思へども飛び立ちかねつ鳥にしあらねば

poems.title: MYS 898: 慰むる心は無しに (Nagusamuru kokoro wa nashi ni)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 5. 題詞: 老身重病年を経て辛苦しみ、また児等を思ふ歌五首 長一首、短四首. The headnote does not itself name Okura; the ascription follows the surrounding 山上憶良 headnotes and 左注
poems.text: 慰むる心は無しに雲隠れ鳴きゆく鳥の音のみし泣かゆ

poems.title: MYS 899: すべもなく苦しくあれば (Sube mo naku kurushiku areba)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 5. 題詞: 老身重病年を経て辛苦しみ、また児等を思ふ歌五首 長一首、短四首. The headnote does not itself name Okura; the ascription follows the surrounding 山上憶良 headnotes and 左注
poems.text: すべもなく苦しくあれば出で走り去ななと思へど子等に障りぬ

poems.title: MYS 905: 若ければ道行き知らじ (Wakakereba michiyuki shiraji)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 5. 題詞: 男子名は古日を恋ふる歌三首 長一首、短二首 (反し歌). The headnote does not itself name Okura; the ascription follows the surrounding 山上憶良 headnotes and 左注
poems.text: 若ければ道行き知らじ賄はせむ下方の使負ひて通らせ

poems.title: MYS 906: 布施置きて吾は祈ひ祷む (Fuse okite ware wa koinomu)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 5. 題詞: 男子名は古日を恋ふる歌三首 長一首、短二首 (反し歌). The headnote does not itself name Okura; the ascription follows the surrounding 山上憶良 headnotes and 左注
poems.text: 布施置きて吾は祈ひ祷む欺かず直に率行きて天道知らしめ

poems.title: MYS 978: 士やも空しかるべき (Onoko yamo munashikarubeki)
poems.author: Yamanoue no Okura
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Man'yōshū book 6. 題詞: 山上臣憶良が沈痾る時の歌一首
poems.text: 士やも空しかるべき万代に語り継ぐべき名は立てずして
